newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India holidays sap overseas vitality.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India holidays sap overseas vitality.

text.p: A market holiday on the Bombay Stock Exchange left London without any strong incentive to trade actively after the National Stock Exchange 50 share index fell 19 points to 962.27.
"There was very little trade here or in India. The local market seems to be stuck in a downward trend," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed down 1.17 points, or 1.66 percent, at 69.07 points, with the premium over the local market at 12.98 percent.

Elsewhere in Asia, the Capel Korea GDR Index ended little changed, up 0.17 points, 0.26 percent, at 67.28 points, a premium of 24.21 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index closed just 0.15 points higher at 781.88.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended down 0.86 points, 0.95 percent, at 89.69 points, a premium of 4.13 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 53.91 points to 6,518.46 points.
